verdict.rationale: Asking whether a developer can run a local or dev instance is a fair deployment-openness question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only a hosted SaaS offering: a free-forever plan, an interactive demo, and API management of environments. These are adjacent conveniences, not a self-hostable, local, or separately deployable instance of the platform. No documentation describes running Honeycomb locally or spinning up a dev instance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a local or dev instance of the platform to test instrumentation and dashboards
